label: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA — fictional community center handbook

questions.question: When does the community center open on weekdays?
questions.evidence: The community center opens at 8:00 AM on weekdays.

questions.question: What time does the center close Monday through Friday?
questions.evidence: The building closes at 9:00 PM Monday through Friday.

questions.question: What are weekend opening hours?
questions.evidence: Weekend hours are 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

questions.question: Where must visitors register?
questions.evidence: Visitors must sign in at the front desk.

questions.question: What should staff wear visibly inside?
questions.evidence: Staff badges must be visible inside the building.

questions.question: Which entrance has a ramp?
questions.evidence: The west entrance is accessible by ramp.

questions.question: How many spaces are in the public parking lot?
questions.evidence: The public parking lot has 42 spaces.

questions.question: Where are bicycle racks located?
questions.evidence: Bicycle racks are located beside the north entrance.

questions.question: Which floor has reception?
questions.evidence: The reception desk is on the ground floor.

questions.question: How many public floors does the building have?
questions.evidence: The building has three public floors.

questions.question: How far in advance can a meeting room be booked?
questions.evidence: Meeting rooms may be reserved up to 60 days in advance.

questions.question: What is the maximum length for a standard room booking?
questions.evidence: A standard room reservation lasts no more than two hours.

questions.question: Do community groups pay for room use?
questions.evidence: Community groups receive room use at no charge.

questions.question: When should a reservation be cancelled?
questions.evidence: Reservations must be cancelled at least 24 hours before the start time.

questions.question: What is the capacity of the largest meeting room?
questions.evidence: The largest meeting room holds 30 people.

questions.question: How many people fit in the small study room?
questions.evidence: The small study room holds 4 people.

questions.question: Where do people collect room keys?
questions.evidence: Room keys are collected from reception.

questions.question: In which room is food permitted?
questions.evidence: Food is allowed only in the conference room.

questions.question: Where is the projector kept?
questions.evidence: The projector is stored in meeting room B.

questions.question: When does a large event need staff approval?
questions.evidence: Events with more than 20 attendees require staff approval.

questions.question: When does program registration begin each month?
questions.evidence: Program registration opens on the first day of each month.

questions.question: Who gets priority for a full class?
questions.evidence: Residents receive priority when a class is full.

questions.question: How many classes may a participant join per season?
questions.evidence: A participant may join up to three classes per season.

questions.question: How many seasonal sessions are held each year?
questions.evidence: The center offers six seasonal sessions each year.

questions.question: How are class cancellations communicated?
questions.evidence: Class cancellations are sent by email.

questions.question: Who must accompany a participant younger than 12?
questions.evidence: Participants under age 12 must attend with an adult.

questions.question: In what season are swimming lessons offered?
questions.evidence: The swimming lesson program is offered in summer.

questions.question: Which day is the art studio closed?
questions.evidence: The art studio is closed on Mondays.

questions.question: What happens when a class reaches capacity?
questions.evidence: A waitlist is used when a class reaches capacity.

questions.question: How long after registration can a refund be requested?
questions.evidence: Refund requests must be submitted within seven days of registration.

questions.question: How many items can a member borrow from the lending library?
questions.evidence: The lending library allows two items per member.

questions.question: What is the loan period for library items?
questions.evidence: Items may be borrowed for 14 days.

questions.question: How much is the daily late return fee?
questions.evidence: A late return fee is one dollar per day.

questions.question: How many plots are in the community garden?
questions.evidence: The community garden has 18 plots.

questions.question: When are garden plot applications due?
questions.evidence: Garden plot applications are due by March 1.

questions.question: How many workstations are in the computer lab?
questions.evidence: The computer lab contains 12 workstations.

questions.question: What is the public computer session limit?
questions.evidence: Public computer sessions are limited to one hour.

questions.question: What is the cost per black-and-white printed page?
questions.evidence: Printing costs ten cents per black-and-white page.

questions.question: Is public Wi-Fi free?
questions.evidence: The center provides free public Wi-Fi.

questions.question: How long is lost property held?
questions.evidence: Lost property is held for 30 days.
